issue.title: Set start of the week to Monday for root locale

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
initial work for simplest approach to set start of the week to monday
other could be using using custom locale provider (extending CLDR and overriding startoftheweek method)
relates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/42588 an issue with investigation details
relates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/41670 bug raised (this won't fix it on its own. joda.parseInto has to be reimplemented
relates  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/43275 fixed

body:
This behaviour is described in [jdk javadoc](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/time/format/DateTimeFormatterBuilder.html#appendPattern-java.lang.String-)
```
    w       1      append special localized WeekFields element for numeric week-of-year
```
It mentioned that this is localized. The code that is responisble for this is here:
```
1 = {StackTraceElement@4560} "java.base/java.time.temporal.WeekFields.of(WeekFields.java:299)"
2 = {StackTraceElement@4561} "java.base/java.time.format.DateTimeFormatterBuilder$WeekBasedFieldPrinterParser.printerParser(DateTimeFormatterBuilder.java:4882)"
3 = {StackTraceElement@4562} "java.base/java.time.format.DateTimeFormatterBuilder$WeekBasedFieldPrinterParser.format(DateTimeFormatterBuilder.java:4866)"
4 = {StackTraceElement@4563} "java.base/java.time.format.DateTimeFormatterBuilder$CompositePrinterParser.format(DateTimeFormatterBuilder.java:2345)"
5 = {StackTraceElement@4564} "java.base/java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.formatTo(DateTimeFormatter.java:1846)"
6 = {StackTraceElement@4565} "java.base/java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.format(DateTimeFormatter.java:1820)"
7 = {StackTraceElement@4566} 
```

issue.title: Set start of the week to Monday for root locale using SPI

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Set start of the week to Monday for root locale (#43652)  …
Introducing a IsoLocal.ROOT constant which should be used instead of java.util.Locale.ROOT in ES when dealing with dates. IsoLocal.ROOT  customises start of the week to be Monday instead of Sunday.

closes #42588 an issue with investigation details
relates #41670 bug raised (this won't fix it on its own. joda.parseInto has to be reimplemented
closes #43275 an issue raised by community member
